description: This is a Flutter application entry point file that sets up the main widget structure for a notes app frontend. It defines the main app widget, a home page with a loading indicator, and utilizes Material Design components.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the application, setting up MaterialApp with a theme and a home page.

classes.name: MyHomePage
classes.description: Stateful widget representing the main page, taking a title as parameter.

classes.name: _MyHomePageState
classes.description: State class for MyHomePage that builds the UI with an app bar and a loading indicator.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the application that runs the MyApp widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for each widget, with implementation in MyApp and _MyHomePageState.
